title: Liberman's goldfish centrifuge-and-freezing experiment

tellings.quote: a lot of this is centered around an experiment he did with goldfish he took four goldfish

plain: A Soviet scientist named Efim Liberman is said to have done an experiment in which he took four goldfish and put them through spinning in a centrifuge and freezing. Michels describes it himself, without naming a source, and mentions Liberman's relatives David and Daniil Liberman. He brings it up in a talk about whether the brain works like a quantum computer that can reach across time.
